_source: docs/design-bible.md: Room condition pool and Hidden Sight hints.

conditions.condition: No one drops below half HP.
conditions.hint: Thils favors those who stay whole.

conditions.condition: An enemy is killed by terrain or a room trick.
conditions.hint: Let the labyrinth do the work.

conditions.condition: The room is cleared in 3 rounds or fewer.
Every player triggers a different boon tag.
No spell slots are spent.
conditions.hint: Keep your magic in your pockets.

conditions.condition: No one takes damage from a room trick.
conditions.hint: Step lightly; the traps are watching.

conditions.condition: Every player drops at least one enemy.
The last enemy falls to a critical hit.
No healing is used.
Every player uses a terrain feature, like a rune, column, cable or ledge.
An enemy is defeated by a room trick it armed itself.
conditions.hint: Let the hunter step in its own snare.

conditions.condition: Someone leaves an offering at a shrine to Thils mid-fight, and the shrine survives.
The true exit is found before the fight ends.
conditions.hint: Know the way out before you need it.

conditions.condition: A player brings an ally back up from 0 HP.
No one misses an attack in the final round.
No player ends a turn more than 30 ft from an ally.
An Absorbed Echo is defeated by a player using the same boon it carried.
conditions.hint: Answer an echo in its own voice.

conditions.condition: No one takes the Dash or Disengage action.
A player finishes the room Bloodied without being healed.
DM's choice: the party did something clever, in character or funny enough to earn it.
